description: This file provides API request functions related to 'assets', including fetching a single asset, posting a new asset, fetching multiple assets with parameters, and deleting an asset. It uses external services such as 'secureApiFetch' and 'requestEntityPost' to perform HTTP requests.

methods.name: requestAsset

methods.name: requestAssets

methods.description: Deletes a specific asset by its ID using a DELETE request.
